Sun.title: Core self
Sun.rules: identity, vitality, the thing you're here to become

Moon.title: Inner world
Moon.rules: emotion, instinct, what makes you feel safe

signs.Aries: Your feelings arrive fast and loud, then leave just as quickly. When you're upset you need action, not comforting.
signs.Taurus: You steady easily and need physical comfort — food, warmth, familiar things — before you can feel genuinely safe.
signs.Gemini: You process emotion by talking it out. Sitting still with a feeling makes you restless; you have to name it to feel it.
signs.Cancer: The Moon rules this sign, so it runs at full strength — you absorb the whole room, and you need a shell to retreat into.
signs.Leo: You need warmth and recognition to feel secure. Your feelings are generous and theatrical, and being ignored cuts deepest.
signs.Virgo: You soothe yourself by fixing things. Low-grade worry is your emotional weather, and being useful is how you feel loved.
signs.Libra: You need harmony to feel settled. Conflict genuinely destabilizes you, and you'll bend a long way to keep the peace.
signs.Scorpio: You feel with an intensity you show almost none of. Trust arrives slowly and then completely, and betrayal is permanent.
signs.Sagittarius: You need room and a horizon. Feeling trapped is your version of drowning, and optimism is how you rescue yourself.
signs.Capricorn: You handle feelings by managing them. You learned early to be the competent one, and softness still reads as unsafe.
signs.Aquarius: You watch your own emotions from a slight distance. You need independence to feel secure, and intimacy on your terms.
signs.Pisces: You feel everyone else's feelings, often before your own. Boundaries are the work; water, art, and solitude are the medicine.

Mercury.title: Mind & voice
Mercury.rules: thinking, speech, learning, how you process information

signs.Aries: You think in sparks and say it before the thought is finished. Fast, blunt, allergic to preamble.
signs.Taurus: Your mind moves slowly on purpose. You turn an idea over in your hands before speaking — and once decided, you don't move.
signs.Gemini: Mercury rules this sign, so your mind is at full power: tangents, footnotes, and a genuine ability to talk to anyone.
signs.Cancer: You think in feelings first and translate to words after. Your memory is emotional — you keep how it felt, not the transcript.
signs.Leo: You speak in headlines. Ideas don't feel real to you until you've said them out loud, with some flourish.
signs.Virgo: Mercury rules this sign too. You catch the loose thread, the typo, the thing that doesn't add up — a mind built for editing.
signs.Libra: You think in both columns at once. Every position has a counter-position, which makes you fair, persuasive, and slow to order lunch.
signs.Scorpio: You don't do small talk. Your mind goes straight underneath — to the motive, the subtext, the thing nobody actually said.
signs.Sagittarius: You think in big arcs and skip the details. Blunt to the point of comedy, three tangents deep, and usually aimed at something true.
signs.Capricorn: Your mind is structural. You want the plan, the timeline, and the point — and you deliberately say less than you know.
signs.Aquarius: You think sideways. The obvious answer bores you, so you find the one nobody tried and explain it as if it were self-evident.
signs.Pisces: You think in images and impressions. Linear argument loses you; metaphor and hunch get you there faster than logic does.

Venus.title: Love & values
Venus.rules: attraction, pleasure, beauty, what you find worth having

signs.Aries: You love at full speed. The chase thrills you, directness is romance, and a relationship that stops being exciting stops.
signs.Taurus: Venus rules this sign. You love with your senses — good food, warm hands, someone who stays. Slow to give, near-impossible to reclaim.
signs.Gemini: You fall for a mind. Conversation is the seduction, boredom is the dealbreaker, and you want the most interesting person in the room.
signs.Cancer: You love by taking care — feeding people, remembering things, building somewhere safe enough to be soft in. You need it back.
signs.Leo: You love generously and out loud. You want to be adored and you adore with your whole chest; indifference wounds worse than fighting.
signs.Virgo: You love through usefulness. You show up, you fix it, you remember the appointment — devotion in a hundred acts you'd never call romantic.
signs.Libra: Venus rules this sign. You're built for partnership — charm and fairness come naturally, though you'd rather keep peace than say the hard thing.
signs.Scorpio: You love completely or not at all. Halfway is worse than nothing; you want intimacy with no exit and no polite version.
signs.Sagittarius: You love freedom first and people second — and the right person knows that isn't rejection. Give you room and you'll keep coming back.
signs.Capricorn: You love seriously. Grand gestures embarrass you; showing up for ten years does not. You're building something, not performing it.
signs.Aquarius: You love unconventionally. Friendship is the foundation, possessiveness is the poison, and you want a partner, not an owner.
signs.Pisces: Venus is exalted here — love without edges. Romantic and forgiving, and prone to loving someone's potential over the actual person.

Mars.title: Drive & anger
Mars.rules: desire, aggression, how you pursue and how you fight

signs.Aries: Mars rules this sign. You act first. Anger arrives fast, burns clean, and is gone — grudges genuinely baffle you.
signs.Taurus: You're almost impossible to provoke, and once provoked, almost impossible to stop. A slow, immovable force.
signs.Gemini: Your fight is verbal — you win with words. Energy scatters across six projects, and novelty is the fuel.
signs.Cancer: You fight sideways: silences, sulks, and sudden fierce protection of whoever you've decided is yours.
signs.Leo: You act with flair and need it witnessed. Anger is loud, theatrical, and quickly over — pride is the button, and it's findable.
signs.Virgo: You channel drive into precision and craft. Your anger comes out as criticism — of others, and far more harshly of yourself.
signs.Libra: You hate conflict and are therefore strangely good at it: passive resistance, charm as a weapon, and a fuse that does eventually run out.
signs.Scorpio: Mars rules this sign traditionally. Your will is relentless and mostly invisible — you don't announce a move, you make it.
signs.Sagittarius: You act on conviction and momentum. Blunt, restless, happiest aimed at something bigger than yourself. Boredom is the real enemy.
signs.Capricorn: Mars is exalted here. Your ambition is patient and structural — you don't rage, you outlast. You were always playing the long game.
signs.Aquarius: You fight for the principle, not the person. Cool-headed, contrary by reflex, immovable once you've judged something simply wrong.
signs.Pisces: Your drive is tidal — enormous when inspired, absent when not. You'd rather dissolve a conflict than win it.

Jupiter.title: Growth & luck
Jupiter.rules: expansion, belief, opportunity, where life is generous with you

signs.Aries: You grow by starting things. Luck shows up when you move first and ask permission never.
signs.Taurus: You grow through steadiness and pleasure. Abundance builds slowly and then, quite suddenly, is simply there.
signs.Gemini: You grow through curiosity and conversation. Your luck lives in the network — the person who knows the person.
signs.Cancer: Jupiter is exalted here. You grow through care, home, and belonging, and generosity comes back to you multiplied.
signs.Leo: You grow by being seen. Confidence is the engine, and fortune tends to find you mid-performance.
signs.Virgo: You grow by mastering the small thing. Your luck looks like preparation meeting an opening nobody else noticed.
signs.Libra: You grow through partnership. The right people open the right doors, and your fairness is what keeps them open.
signs.Scorpio: You grow through depth and crisis. What nearly ruins you tends to become the source of your power.
signs.Sagittarius: Jupiter rules this sign. You grow through travel, philosophy, and faith — you're the one people call lucky, and mostly you are.
signs.Capricorn: You grow through discipline. Your good fortune is unglamorous, slow, and permanent once it finally arrives.
signs.Aquarius: You grow through community and ideas ahead of their time. Luck comes from the strange project nobody else backed.
signs.Pisces: Jupiter rules this sign traditionally. You grow through compassion and imagination, and you're rescued, repeatedly, by things you can't explain.

Saturn.title: Limits & mastery
Saturn.rules: discipline, fear, time, the lesson you're here to actually learn

signs.Aries: Your lesson is patience — learning, slowly, that starting is not finishing, and that your anger needs somewhere to go.
signs.Taurus: Your lesson is enough. Fear of scarcity makes you hold too tightly; mastery is working out what actually needs keeping.
signs.Gemini: Your lesson is depth. A mind this quick learns the hard way that knowing a little about everything isn't knowing something.
signs.Cancer: Saturn sits uneasily here. Your lesson is safety — you had to build your own, and learning to need people is a life's work.
signs.Leo: Your lesson is worth without applause: valuing yourself when nobody is clapping, which is the only version that holds.
signs.Virgo: Your lesson is sufficiency in your work. The standard you hold was never reachable; mastery is setting a real one.
signs.Libra: Saturn is exalted here. Your lesson is fairness with teeth — real commitment, real boundaries, and the conversation you keep postponing.
signs.Scorpio: Your lesson is control: learning what you actually get to hold, and what must be surrendered before it takes you with it.
signs.Sagittarius: Your lesson is conviction that survives contact with reality. Your faith gets tested, and what's left is genuinely yours.
signs.Capricorn: Saturn rules this sign. Your lesson is authority — becoming the adult you kept waiting for, and forgiving how long it took.
signs.Aquarius: Saturn rules this sign traditionally. Your lesson is belonging without disappearing: the group matters, and so does the part that won't conform.
signs.Pisces: Your lesson is boundaries — where you end and everyone else begins, and that compassion without limits drowns you both.

Uranus.title: Disruption
Uranus.rules: rebellion, invention, the sudden break with what came before

signs.Aries: A generation that broke things open by force — new selfhood, new conflicts, new beginnings.
signs.Taurus: A generation rewriting money, land, food, and what security is even supposed to mean.
signs.Gemini: A generation reinventing how information moves — and discovering how fast a lie travels with it.
signs.Cancer: A generation that redefined family, home, and who gets to count as kin.
signs.Leo: A generation that broke the rules of fame and self-expression, and of who gets to be a star.
signs.Virgo: A generation that overhauled work, health, and the systems quietly running daily life.
signs.Libra: A generation that rewrote marriage, partnership, and the terms of fairness between people.
signs.Scorpio: A generation that dragged sex, death, power, and secrets into the open.
signs.Sagittarius: A generation that upended belief — religion, education, and who gets to say what's true.
signs.Capricorn: A generation that cracked institutions, governments, and inherited authority.
signs.Aquarius: Uranus rules this sign. A generation built for radical reinvention of the collective itself.
signs.Pisces: A generation that dissolved boundaries — spiritual, artistic, chemical, and digital.

Neptune.title: Dream & illusion
Neptune.rules: imagination, longing, spirituality, and the blind spot that comes with it

signs.Aries: A generation dreaming of the heroic self — and vulnerable to believing its own myth.
signs.Taurus: A generation idealizing the earth and the simple life, and unclear about what wealth is actually for.
signs.Gemini: A generation enchanted by information, and unable to separate the story from its source.
signs.Cancer: A generation nostalgic for a home that may never have existed.
signs.Leo: A generation that made idols of performers and mistook glamour for meaning.
signs.Virgo: A generation that dreamed of purity and usefulness, and made a religion of self-improvement.
signs.Libra: A generation idealizing love itself, and slow to see a partner as an actual person.
signs.Scorpio: A generation drawn to the taboo and the transformative, fascinated by what it also fears.
signs.Sagittarius: A generation searching for meaning everywhere and allergic to any single answer.
signs.Capricorn: A generation that dreamed of building something solid while watching the structures dissolve.
signs.Aquarius: A generation dreaming collectively — utopian, networked, and easily swept up together.
signs.Pisces: Neptune rules this sign. A generation soaked in imagination and compassion, and challenged to tell vision from illusion.

Pluto.title: Power & rebirth
Pluto.rules: transformation, obsession, what must be destroyed to be remade

signs.Aries: A generation transformed through raw will and the assertion of the individual.
signs.Taurus: A generation that will tear down and rebuild money, ownership, and the land itself.
signs.Gemini: A generation that transformed thought and language — and lived through their weaponization.
signs.Cancer: A generation reshaped by upheaval in the home: war, displacement, and the family remade.
signs.Leo: A generation that seized personal power and put the self at the center of the story.
signs.Virgo: A generation that overturned work, medicine, and the machinery of ordinary life.
signs.Libra: A generation that rebuilt relationships and equality from the ground up.
signs.Scorpio: Pluto rules this sign. A generation intimate with power, death, and everything kept hidden.
signs.Sagittarius: A generation that blew open belief, borders, and the global story.
signs.Capricorn: A generation dismantling institutions and inherited power structures.
signs.Aquarius: A generation transforming the collective — technology, networks, and who holds power in a crowd.
signs.Pisces: A generation dissolving the old order to find what's sacred underneath.

Ascendant.title: Rising sign
Ascendant.rules: the mask you meet the world in
Ascendant.note: The exact degree rising on the eastern horizon at your birth. Needs birth time and place.

Midheaven.title: Public role
Midheaven.rules: career, reputation, what you're known for
Midheaven.note: The highest point of the ecliptic at your birth — the cusp of the 10th house.

North Node.title: Growth direction
North Node.rules: the unfamiliar direction you're being pulled toward
North Node.note: Where the Moon's orbit crosses the ecliptic going north. Always moves backwards through the zodiac.

signs.Aries: Growth looks like acting before consensus. The old skill is accommodation; the new one is saying what you want first and tolerating the discomfort.
signs.Taurus: Growth looks like slowing down and keeping what you have. The old skill is crisis and intensity; the new one is steady, unglamorous enough.
signs.Gemini: Growth looks like asking instead of pronouncing. The old skill is the big picture; the new one is curiosity about the particular person in front of you.
signs.Cancer: Growth looks like letting yourself be cared for. The old skill is competence in public; the new one is admitting what you need at home.
signs.Leo: Growth looks like taking the stage as yourself, not the group. The old skill is the network; the new one is individual, nameable creative risk.
signs.Virgo: Growth looks like doing the practical next thing. The old skill is faith and drift; the new one is the checklist, the craft, the repair.
signs.Libra: Growth looks like partnership on equal terms. The old skill is self-sufficiency; the new one is letting someone else's needs actually change the plan.
signs.Scorpio: Growth looks like depth over comfort. The old skill is stability; the new one is intimacy that costs something and change you didn't choose.
signs.Sagittarius: Growth looks like trusting your own read. The old skill is gathering more information; the new one is committing to a direction on less.
signs.Capricorn: Growth looks like structure and public responsibility. The old skill is retreat and caretaking; the new one is building something that outlasts the mood.
signs.Aquarius: Growth looks like the group, not the spotlight. The old skill is personal brilliance; the new one is contributing to something you don't get credit for.
signs.Pisces: Growth looks like surrender and mercy. The old skill is analysis and fixing; the new one is accepting what can't be corrected.

South Node.title: Comfort zone
South Node.rules: what already comes easily — and what you over-rely on

Part of Fortune.title: Ease & flourishing
Part of Fortune.rules: where things click without forcing them
Part of Fortune.note: An Arabic Part built from your Sun, Moon and Ascendant — the formula flips between day and night births.

Lilith.title: What you were taught to bury
Lilith.rules: the appetite or edge you learned to apologise for
Lilith.note: The Moon's mean apogee — the far, empty focus of its orbit. A calculated point, not a body. This is mean Lilith, the ephemeris standard; true Lilith wobbles a few degrees either side.

signs.Aries: The part of you that wants to go first and say it plainly. You learned that wanting was rude, so anger arrives before the want does.
signs.Taurus: Appetite — for comfort, for money, for being enjoyed without earning it. You learned to call it indulgence and ration it.
signs.Gemini: The thing you actually think, before you soften it. You learned your unedited voice was too much, so you got very good at the edit.
signs.Cancer: Need. Wanting to be held, fed, chosen. You learned that needing was a burden, so you became the one who holds instead.
signs.Leo: The wish to be looked at and adored. You learned that was vanity, so you perform competence and let the wanting go hungry.
signs.Virgo: The right to be imperfect and still be useful. You learned that worth was earned by correction, so rest reads as failure.
signs.Libra: Your own preference, stated without a survey. You learned that agreeableness was the price of company, so 'whatever you want' became a reflex.
signs.Scorpio: Depth, hunger, the refusal to be casual. You learned that intensity frightens people, so you keep it behind a very calm face.
signs.Sagittarius: The belief you're not supposed to say out loud, and the urge to leave. You learned that certainty was arrogance and wandering was avoidance.
signs.Capricorn: Ambition without an apology attached. You learned that wanting authority was cold, so you take responsibility and refuse the credit.
signs.Aquarius: The part that will not fall in line. You learned that difference costs belonging, so you either hide it or lead with it and stay outside.
signs.Pisces: Longing that has no practical use. You learned that dreaming was escape, so you stay useful and let the ache go somewhere private.

houses.name: Self & body
houses.meaning: How you show up before you've said a word — appearance, instinct, the opening impression.

houses.name: Money & worth
houses.meaning: What you own, what you earn, and the quieter question of what you believe you're worth.

houses.name: Mind & siblings
houses.meaning: Everyday thinking, talking, writing, short trips, and the people you grew up alongside.

houses.name: Home & roots
houses.meaning: Family, ancestry, the private self, and the place you go when the door closes.

houses.name: Creativity & romance
houses.meaning: Play, art, flirtation, children, and anything you make purely because you wanted to.

houses.name: Work & health
houses.meaning: Routine, craft, service, the body's maintenance — the unglamorous engine of a life.

houses.name: Partnership
houses.meaning: One-to-one relationships: marriage, close collaborators, and open rivals.

houses.name: Depth & shared resources
houses.meaning: Intimacy, other people's money, death, debt, and everything genuinely transformative.

houses.name: Belief & horizon
houses.meaning: Philosophy, long journeys, higher study, and the search for what it all means.

houses.name: Career & reputation
houses.meaning: Your public role, ambition, and what strangers know you for.

houses.name: Community & hopes
houses.meaning: Friends, groups, causes, and the future you're building toward with other people.

houses.name: The hidden
houses.meaning: Solitude, the unconscious, what's behind you, and what undoes you when unexamined.

aspects.name: Conjunction
aspects.meaning: Two forces sharing the same degree of sky. They amplify and contaminate each other — from here neither one ever acts alone.

aspects.name: Sextile
aspects.meaning: An easy channel between two parts of you — but one that stays shut unless you actually use it.

aspects.name: Square
aspects.meaning: Two drives pulling at right angles. It's uncomfortable, and it's also the engine — squares are where the work gets done.

aspects.name: Trine
aspects.meaning: A talent that costs you nothing, which is exactly why it's the easiest thing in the chart to waste.

aspects.name: Opposition
aspects.meaning: Two forces facing each other across the wheel. You swing between them until you learn to hold both at once.

Grand trine.meaning: Three placements in easy, closed circuit with each other. Talent that arrives without being worked for — which is exactly why it's the easiest thing in the chart to coast on. A grand trine tends to be noticed by everyone except the person who has it.

Grand cross.meaning: Two oppositions locked at right angles — four placements all pulling against each other. Nothing here resolves by choosing a side; the configuration only settles when all four get a real place in your life. It's the hardest shape to carry and the most durable once carried.

T-square.meaning: An opposition with a third placement squaring both ends. The apex is where the tension collects and where the pressure keeps announcing itself — it's the sore spot and the engine at once. Most of the chart's drive routes through it.

Stellium.meaning: Three or more planets crowded into a single sign — and so, under whole-sign houses, into a single house. That area of life gets a disproportionate share of your attention, for better and worse: it's where you're most fluent, most invested, and most likely to mistake your own intensity for the way things simply are.
